follow-up time: 90 days postpartum, with subsequent pregnancy status assessed at 1 year
cohort: 1331 women with a documented contraceptive plan of sterilization at the time of postpartum discharge
finding: While there were initial differences in sterilization fulfillment rates based on insurance type, these differences were not significant after adjusting for clinical and demographic factors.
mod_finding: The study adjusted for mode of delivery as a potential confounder but did not report specific findings related to mode of delivery and postpartum sterilization fulfillment.
